 Coverage by Juan Carlos Vera López Updated October 24, 2026, 7:22 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 7:22 PM ET 88' 7:22 PM ET 8 minutes ago We’re in the final stretch of the match; it remains to be seen how much stoppage time the referee will add to a game that’s getting increasingly heated as the minutes tick by. Miami has a significant set-piece opportunity—let’s see if they can level the score.

 Key moments
 6:30 PM ET 45' Halftime 
 5:49 PM ET 10' Own goal (Casemiro) · New York Red Bulls 1-0 
 5:39 PM ET Kickoff 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 84' 7:20 PM ET 11 minutes ago Final minutes of the match—we are 6 minutes plus stoppage time away from the end—and Miami isn’t giving up; they keep pushing, searching for an equalizer. It’s a thrilling finish, great close in this match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 80' 7:16 PM ET 14 minutes ago New York is also making changes, aiming to be much more offensive and to close out this match—which is reaching an exciting conclusion in the best possible way; there are 10 minutes left to play, great close.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 76' 7:15 PM ET 15 minutes ago We are approaching the final 10 minutes of the match, and New York has come very close to scoring a goal that would have given them more breathing room in what has been a very tight and exciting contest—a great finish to the match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 72' 7:07 PM ET 23 minutes ago Inter Miami is making adjustments with the aim of being much more aggressive and pushing for an equalizer; Messi has now entered the pitch, looking to turn the scoreline around—the match is being played at a great pace.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 68' 7:00 PM ET 31 minutes ago High intensity but little clarity in this second half, which has seen few goal-scoring opportunities; the score remains 1-0 in favor of New York, who have managed the match well, while the fans continue to cheer.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 64' 6:59 PM ET 31 minutes ago New York is defending exceptionally well, denying Miami any space; it’s a very difficult match for the visitors, who are beginning to grow desperate as they fail to create any real threat—the coaches are already preparing their substitutions.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 60' 6:53 PM ET 37 minutes ago Substitute players are getting up to warm up in preparation for potential substitutions; the pace of the match has slowed, with few goal-scoring opportunities, and it remains to be seen how both teams will make adjustments for the conclusion of this great encounter.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 56' 6:50 PM ET 40 minutes ago The coaches are already conferring with their assistants to prepare adjustments for this second half; New York keeps up the pressure and looks better in this second half, while Miami is struggling significantly in its defensive zone.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 52' 6:47 PM ET 43 minutes ago Inter Miami is trying to push forward to create a threat, but they are losing possession very quickly; there is a lot of intensity, but a lack of clarity during this stretch of the match, and the coaches are constantly giving instructions throughout this second half.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 48' 6:47 PM ET 44 minutes ago There are no changes for this second half; the same 22 players take the field for the remainder of the match, with New York maintaining their lead and continuing to press in search of a second goal that would allow them to play with greater composure.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 45' 6:30 PM ET an hour ago Halftime
 The first half ends with the score at 1-0 in favor of the New York Red Bulls against Inter Miami. It’s been a great match so far; we’ll see how both teams make adjustments for the final 45 minutes, great match at moment.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 42' 6:17 PM ET an hour ago Entering the final stretch of the first half; we’ll see how much stoppage time the referee adds to this match, which is shaping up to be an exciting finish to the half. Miami isn’t letting up on the intensity and is pushing for an equalizer before the break.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 38' 6:14 PM ET an hour ago Final minutes of the first half; we are 7 minutes—plus stoppage time—away from the break in a match that has been dominated by one team. The hosts look motivated and will be aiming to finish this first half on a high note.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 34' 6:09 PM ET an hour ago There are many fouls being committed that prevent the ball from flowing smoothly; Miami is frequently disrupting play in an effort to regain possession. It’s a very intense and tight first half in this MLS match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 30' 6:08 PM ET an hour ago We’ve reached the 30-minute mark and the score remains unchanged; New York holds the lead and is defending well during this stretch of the match—they are effective on the counterattack, but have struggled to finish their chances.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 26' 6:03 PM ET an hour ago Miami is struggling defensively, unable to shake off the pressure from the home side, who are very close to scoring a second goal. The fans continue to cheer in what has been a highly exciting match, featuring two potent attacking sides.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 22' 5:59 PM ET 2 hours ago An incredible miss by New York with the goal left wide open the ball sailed over the crossbar. Inter Miami gets a major reprieve, having come close to falling two goals behind; the home side has been much better in this first half.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 18' 5:56 PM ET 2 hours ago The pace of the match has slowed slightly, and Inter Miami has begun pushing the ball forward, looking to unlock New York’s defensive setup; it has become an end-to-end contest, with scoring opportunities at both ends of the pitch.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 14' 5:50 PM ET 2 hours ago The pace of the match is picking up as the minutes go by, and the coaches have been constantly shouting instructions; there is great intensity in this first half, with the home side spurred on by the fact that they are already ahead on the scoreboard.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10' 5:49 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for New York! The hosts take the lead thanks to an own goal by Casemiro, who makes a mistake and puts the ball into his own net. The home side has been the better team in this great match, great match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6' 5:44 PM ET 2 hours ago Inter Miami pushes forward, while the hosts—relying on speed along the flanks—look to deliver crosses and break the deadlock; they come very close to the opening goal following a well-placed ball from Cowell—the home side is looking much better.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 3' 5:41 PM ET 2 hours ago There is an intense battle for the ball in midfield, and the Red Bulls are currently looking to press and create their first dangerous attacking opportunities; it’s a great start to the match, with high pressure from both sides and a fast pace of play.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:39 PM ET 2 hours ago Kickoff
 The first half between New York and Inter Miami has begun, the initial whistle has blown and both teams immediately go forward to create danger, a great start to the match at the Red Bull Arena, great start.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:21 PM ET 2 hours ago All ready
 Everything is set for the start of the match; the players are ready and awaiting the signal to take the field for the opening whistle. New York and Inter Miami will both be looking to secure all 3 points in this big match at Red Bull Arena.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:16 PM ET 2 hours ago End of warmup
 The players finish their warm-up and head back to their dressing rooms to receive final instructions from their coaches, before returning to the pitch for the start of the first 45 minutes of this big MLS match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:06 PM ET 2 hours ago Inter Miami lineup
 This is the Inter Miami lineup as they look to secure a win and all 3 points on the road; Messi has been placed on the bench for this match, while the players continue their warm-up on the pitch, great lineup:
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:03 PM ET 2 hours ago New York lineup
 Here is the Red Bulls lineup to face Miami in what promises to be an exciting match; they are fielding their best players in pursuit of a win and all 3 points, playing at home in front of their own fans:
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Fans
 Fans of the Red Bulls and Miami are now entering Red Bull Arena for this big MLS match; a full-capacity crowd is expected, and the players are already warming up on the pitch, great entrance in this game.
